objective: Close enforcement holes in the 15-call anti-stall budget without changing scientific scope.
corrections: An open expensive unit makes call 11 checkpoint/persist-only and requires durable=true+success.
No open expensive unit may survive beyond call 11.
durable=true is legal only for checkpoint or persist.
At most one expensive unit may be started per execution block, even if the first is persisted early.
Block close is forbidden whenever an expensive unit remains open.
Hard-cap reason remains explicit at/after call 15.
